name: bibzcode-ide
description: BibzCode IDE with Theia workbench and VS Code extension compatibility.

scripts.package:linux: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux deb rpm AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:amd64: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux deb rpm AppImage --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:arm64: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux deb rpm AppImage --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:linux:armv7l: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux deb rpm AppImage --armv7l --publish never
scripts.package:windows: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.package:windows:portable: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win portable --publish never
scripts.package:windows:installer: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
